objective: Implement only the backend Telegram Mini App owner-auth contract on a server branch. Add Telegram initData verification, short-lived session issuance, role mapping, redaction-safe responses and fixed signed fixtures/tests. Do not implement Mini App UI, task mutation APIs, Telegram live receiver changes, webhook changes, service restarts, payments, Guest Mode, Business mode or Bot-to-Bot behavior.
required_behavior: Validate Telegram Mini App initData server-side using the official Telegram WebApp HMAC contract.
Reject missing, malformed, stale, replayed or signature-invalid initData.
Expose a minimal backend session endpoint for Mini App auth without adding task mutation APIs.
Map verified Telegram users to Kolibri roles using configured owner/operator/reviewer/observer allowlists or safe defaults.
Return only redaction-safe response fields; never echo bot tokens, raw initData, full hashes, private messages, owner chat IDs or environment secrets.
Use deterministic tests with fixed non-secret bot-token fixtures.
Keep existing Telegram gateway behavior unchanged.
Do not call Telegram Bot API or any live Telegram endpoint.
verification_commands: git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD | grep -E '^(frontend/|ops/|infra/|\.github/|docs/superfactory/|docs/agent/dispatcher/)' && exit 1 || true
acceptance: Server branch is created and pushed; no push to main and no force push.
Telegram Mini App initData verification is implemented in backend code with focused tests.
Short-lived role/session response exists and is redaction-safe.
Unauthorized, malformed, stale and bad-signature cases are covered by tests.
No frontend, ops, runtime service, webhook, live bot receiver, command menu, payment, Business, Guest Mode or Bot-to-Bot changes are made.
No Telegram token, owner chat id, cookies, passwords, API keys, private messages or raw initData are printed into logs/artifacts.
Existing Telegram gateway tests continue to pass or any missing dependency blocker is reported honestly.
Exact five run artifacts are created.
Remote result reports task_id, node, Russian agent display name, branch/PR, tests, blockers and next remote dispatch command.
